contentText: President Donald Trump called off new U.S. military strikes on Iran on Thursday, saying "final points" of an initial peace deal had been approved and details of a signing ​ceremony would ‌be announced shortly. Iran's semi-official Fars news agency reported that Tehran had not approved ⁠the text of any agreement. Since mid-March, Trump has repeatedly claimed that a deal with Iran to ‌end the war is close. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland and Monte Francis report.
